svg.title: The reading tree and its little rowboat
svg.desc: Hand-composed flat SVG. An oak from the Home plant kit shades a little reading picnic, with an ochre rowboat, paired oars, tether, daisies and shore pebbles. The short diagonal jetty contains the exact bridge-jetty-5 paths. All geometry in viewBox units.

g.title: Wide forked oak
g.desc: A low, broad crown of five irregular leaf masses, with a relatively flat top. Thick leaning trunk divides into two long exposed limbs under the canopy. Bottom-centre ground anchor (150, 380). Ducky height 130.
